setup.banner: The Quick Actions are not installed yet. Open the “Getting started” tab.
setup.intro: Flect works from Finder's right-click menu. Do these steps once.
setup.step1.title: 1. Install the Quick Actions
setup.step1.body: Adds the Flect items to your Library. Finder restarts once afterwards (open Finder windows reopen).
setup.step1.failed: The Quick Actions could not be installed.
setup.step2.title: 2. Switch them on in System Settings
setup.step2.body: macOS leaves new Quick Actions off. In the screen that opens, click the (i) button next to “Finder” and switch on every “Flect: …” item. If an item does not show up in Finder, restart Finder or log in again.
setup.step3.title: 3. Use them
setup.step3.body: Right-click a file in Finder → Quick Actions → Flect. The “Required tools” tab shows the extra tools (ffmpeg and so on) that some items need.
update.title: 4. Updates

update.privacy: A check makes one HTTPS request to GitHub (api.github.com) and sends nothing about you or your Mac. Nothing is installed automatically; you download the new version yourself.
